annotations.title: Add a media file from a link

description: Add one file by its public web address: PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4 or LinkedIn PDF, up to 10 MB. The service fetches it once and stores it; answers its media id, as media_upload does. Use it when the user points at a file that is already online. Refused when the address is not a public https one, cannot be fetched, is too large, or leads to a page instead of a file.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for people who cannot see it. Kept with the file.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

name.description: A file name for the user’s own list. Taken from the address when left out.

url.description: The https address of the file itself, one that opens the file in a browser without signing in. Not the address of a page that shows it.

name: media_from_url
title: Add a media file from a link
